name: What preparatory steps should I take before discussing a walk-in tub project with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What preparatory steps should I take before discussing a walk-in tub project with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before discussing a walk-in tub project, homeowners should consider their primary motivations, such as specific accessibility needs or desired comfort features, and any preliminary ideas for their luxury bathroom aesthetic. Gathering inspirational images or noting current bathroom challenges can also be helpful. This initial reflection aids AKN Design Group in understanding your vision and needs during the initial consultation. Our managed process then takes over, translating your ideas into detailed design plans and a seamless construction experience, ensuring a customized renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before meeting, consider your motivations, desired features, and aesthetic preferences for your walk-in tub project to help us understand your vision.
